support_donate_sub: Keep the server running and get a few perks for it.
support_donate_expires_thanks: . Thank you for helping us keep RealistikOsu up and alive! <3
support_donate_add_more: You can add more time below.
support_donate_reason_cost_title: We don't run it for free
support_donate_reason_cost_text: The server is free and always will be, but not on our end. We pay for it out of our own pockets.
support_donate_reason_students_text: All of our staff are students without a steady income. Even a small donation goes a long way.
support_donate_reason_honest_text: This optional donation is the only money we ask for. We never sell or misuse your data.
support_donate_perk_names_text: Change your name as often as you like, as long as it follows the rules.
support_donate_perk_profile_text: An incredibly cool supporter badge, your own profile banner and a custom badge.
support_donate_perk_decorations_text: Extra username styles on top of the default ones.
support_donate_perk_avatar_text: Upload a GIF as your avatar and it plays everywhere it shows up.
support_donate_perk_discord_text: A supporter role on our Discord, with supporter-only channels.
support_donate_perk_wipe_text: Hide that ridiculous play count or your 500 retries on Padoru. Ask for a wipe.
support_donate_unavailable: Payments are currently unavailable. Please try again later.
support_donate_paypal_card: Or a card linked to PayPal
support_donate_paid: Thank you! Your supporter will show up in a moment.
support_team_sub: The people who keep RealistikOsu, the server and its community, running.
support_team_error: Couldn't load the team. Try again in a bit.
support_team_developers_text: Developers do all the server-side magic and the technical work behind the scenes. They have full power over the server as they run it, and have a blue name in the in-game chat.
support_team_admins_text: Administrators make sure everything runs smoothly, from organising events to hunting cheaters. They're cool people ready to help you, with power over many areas like the Discord server.
support_team_community_text: Community Managers deal with bans, silences, name changes and pretty much everything to do with the community. They look after our Discord server and answer support requests there.
support_team_chat_mods_text: Chat Moderators keep an eye on the chat to make sure The Law™ (the rules) is respected.
support_team_bat_text: BATs play beatmaps in the ranking queue and decide whether they're good enough to be ranked.
support_team_social_text: The Social Media Team handles everything to do with RealistikOsu's presence on social media.
support_team_alumni_text: Former team members who have stepped down, but whose work helped shape RealistikOsu into what it is today.

support_about_sub: A custom server for the rhythm game osu!, building on the online experience with lots of fun features.
support_about_leaderboards_text: Every map has its own leaderboard in-game for vanilla, relax and autopilot, with clan tags next to names.
support_about_online_text: See who's online from the in-game user panel, along with their rank, pp and what they're up to.
support_about_direct_text: osu!direct works for everyone, no supporter tag needed. Search for maps and download them without leaving the game.
support_about_global_text: Rankings for every mode, by pp or by score, and for every country.
support_about_requests_text: Found an unranked map you like? Send it in, and the Beatmap Appreciation Team will check the whole set.
support_about_spectator_text: Watch other players live, right from the game.
support_about_multi_text: Make or join a lobby and play against others, just like on the official server.
support_about_bot_text: Our in-game bot. Ask it for pp with {withCmd}, roll with {rollCmd}, and see everything else it can do with {helpCmd}.
support_about_more_text: RealistikOsu was first released to the public in early 2020, and has grown an unbelievable amount since. We have a long journey ahead of us, so come along and watch it unfold.
support_about_open_source: We're also open source, so you can see the exact code we run and even contribute to it.
support_patcher_lead: The RealistikOsu patcher makes relax play better. It brings back things like ranking panels, and adds rate changes and a pp counter on top.
support_patcher_step_install_text: It installs the patcher on your PC.
support_patcher_step_open_text: Start it whenever you want to play on RealistikOsu.
